svg.title: AI Collaboration Record — All time
svg.desc: 1173 AI-attributed commits, 1197 AI actor presences across 94 active AI days (author dates), 2 AI providers. Collaboration terrain 2026-05-11 to 2026-08-02, peak day 138 commits; height is total commits, hue is the day's AI share; publishable repositories only. Generated 2026-08-01.
